title: Exactly one payload when issuing
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2. Step 1 — Select the payload type; QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set; HCERT Specification, 3.2.7 Health Certificate Claim. QR Code Generation, 2. Step 1 — Select the payload type: “Carrying exactly one is an implementation choice, not a constraint of the container, and it is the choice made throughout this page.”. HCERT Specification, 3.2.7 Health Certificate Claim: “Several different types of health certificate MAY exist under the same claim”. The statement is a deliberate profile, stricter than the container: the owner chose on 2026-10-22 to keep exactly one payload per certificate, and to refuse several (bean OI-02).

statements.label: Exactly one payload when issuing
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL emit an hcert (-260) map with exactly one entry. The verifier SHALL fail verification with MultipleSubclaims when there is more than one entry, and with HcertMissing when there is none.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-SEL-004 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-SEL-004 an issued HCERT carries exactly one payload` (SelectPayloadTest.kt)).
